{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin Repulsor Speedway''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] track that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race was held on the course.
